# gns3_template (List Resource)

Lists the user templates on the GNS3 controller (`GET /v2/templates`). Built-in templates (VPCS, Ethernet switch, ...) are left out unless `include_builtin = true`, because `gns3_template` cannot manage or import them. With resources included, `properties` is null, as after `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later. Put this file beside the root
# module's .tf files and run: terraform query
list "gns3_template" "all" {
  provider = gns3
}

# Only qemu templates, with every attribute rather than the identity alone.
list "gns3_template" "qemu" {
  provider         = gns3
  include_resource = true

  config {
    template_type = "qemu"
  }
}

# Built-in templates too (VPCS, Ethernet switch, ...), for a look at what the
# server has. Built-ins can't be imported into gns3_template.
list "gns3_template" "everything" {
  provider = gns3

  config {
    include_builtin = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_builtin` (Boolean) Also list built-in templates (`builtin = true`). Default `false`. For looking at what the server has: a built-in result cannot be imported into `gns3_template`.
- `template_type` (String) List only templates of this type: one of `cloud`, `nat`, `ethernet_hub`, `ethernet_switch`, `docker`, `dynamips`, `vpcs`, `traceng`, `virtualbox`, `vmware`, `iou`, `qemu`. All types when unset.
